capabilities: Transcribe handwritten text from supported vault images
Write extracted text to a selected destination note or files
Run OCR through plugin commands on the current note or selection
Connect a Constance account and buy credits for AI usage
extras: Freemium: a free allowance exists and further use requires purchased credits (Paddle, USD). Selected note and image contents are sent to an external AI service; error reports with possible file paths or content go to Datadog. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian cannot extract text from handwritten content in images or PDFs, leaving such material unsearchable.

requires.name: purchased credits beyond the free allowance

summary: Handwriting OCR plugin that transcribes text from vault images and PDF pages into Markdown using the GPT-5 mini model.
